---
title: "NCAA Tournament Wins — Exploratory Linear Regression"
author: "Cole Rajaratnam"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}
data <- read_project_data <- function() {
  candidates <- c("data/kenpom_tournament_data.csv", "../data/kenpom_tournament_data.csv")
  paths <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    stop("Missing KenPom data: see data/README.md for instructions.")
  }
  read.csv(paths[1], check.names = TRUE)
}
data <- read_project_data()
```

```{r}
model1 <- lm(Wins.0.6. ~ Seed + AdjOE + AdjDE, data = data)
summary(model1)
```

```{r}
model2 <- lm(Wins.0.6. ~ Seed + AdjOE + AdjDE + Coach + AP.Top.25 + Top.12 + X4. + Top21_O + Top37_D, data = data)

summary(model2)
```

```{r}
data$ProfileScore <- data$Coach + data$AP.Top.25 + data$Top.12 + data$X4. + data$Top21_O + data$Top37_D
```

```{r}
lm(Wins.0.6. ~ ProfileScore + Seed, data=data)
```

```{r}
champions <- subset(data, Wins.0.6. == 6)
mean(champions$ProfileScore)
```
```{r}
mean(data$ProfileScore)
```
```{r}
aggregate(Wins.0.6. ~ ProfileScore, data = data, mean)
```

```{r}
seed_expectation <- aggregate(Wins.0.6. ~ Seed, data = data, mean)
seed_expectation
```

```{r}
data <- merge(data, seed_expectation, by = "Seed")
```

```{r}
data$Overperformance <- data$Wins.0.6..x - data$Wins.0.6..y
```

```{r}
model3 <- lm(Overperformance ~ Coach + AP.Top.25 + Top.12 + X4. + Top21_O + Top37_D, data = data)
summary(model3)
```

```{r}
max(data$ProfileScore)
```

```{r}
min(champions$ProfileScore)
```
